metadata.status_scope: The detailed inventory heading and legend explicitly classify exactly Dammam DDC306, Bahrain DC, and RUH - New Mursalat as under construction at the end of reporting year 2024. Each supports one generic project-level under_construction observation as of 2024-12-31, but no more specific physical stage.
metadata.internal_inconsistency_guardrail: The adjacent Phase 4 narrative instead says three facilities in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Bahrain were underway. Because that location list conflicts with the detailed inventory's Dammam, Bahrain, and RUH - New Mursalat list, this tranche normalizes only the three explicitly named detailed-inventory entries and creates no Jeddah record. It does not claim the two lists are identical.
metadata.historical_status_guardrail: The report supplies a historical end-2024 construction classification. It does not establish that any listed project's status remained unchanged, advanced, or completed after 2024-12-31.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The Phase 4 narrative's 20 MW IT-shell and 10.8 MW initial IT-load totals refer to its conflicting Riyadh/Jeddah/Bahrain grouping and cannot be allocated to the detailed Dammam/Bahrain/RUH inventory. The 125 MW and 92 MW figures are portfolio totals. None creates a project or campus capacity row.
metadata.role_guardrail: The report does not assign a sufficiently explicit standardized owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, user, contractor, utility, or investor role to any one of the three detailed-inventory projects, so roles remain empty.
metadata.classification_guardrail: Cloud-enabled, AI, hosting, sustainability, and energy-efficiency language is portfolio-level or design-program context and creates no project workload or operating-model observation.
metadata.location_guardrail: The report identifies Dammam, Bahrain, and Riyadh/RUH only at city or country level and supplies no street address, parcel, authoritative point, footprint, geometry, or unique-site count.
metadata.energy_guardrail: PUE-improvement discussion is portfolio-level and unquantified on the selected page. The source establishes no project-specific PUE, grid connection, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption.
